scope: GM1 controls parts delta against Rev I's selected controls schedule (output/design-finish-2026-09-26/controls/selected-components.json). Unpriced; no order, quote or stock check. Check terminal marks, coil currents and minimum loads against each maker's datasheet at purchase. Updated later on 27 Sep 2026 for M9-M11, the cutter-side start relay and the Rev K cabinet parts, and again for M12-M13 (Rev L tool changer). M14 (the same evening) adds the Z top switch contact in the dock feed. M17-M20 (28 Sep 2026) add three door pilot lamps, the work light on the gantry beam, the dock's tool setter in the head loop with its bridge relay, and a second E-stop station.
